overview: The Cozy Hook is a premium handmade crochet e-commerce boutique featuring 43 products across 5 categories, a soft pastel aesthetic, WhatsApp-based checkout, floating chat assistant, and an admin dashboard for managing featured products.
features: 43 handmade crochet products across Plushies, Keychains, Wearables, Home Decor, and Accessories
Slide-out cart drawer with localStorage persistence and WhatsApp checkout
Floating chat assistant with question types and quick-reply buttons
Password-protected admin dashboard to edit featured products and hero text
Custom orders via Google Form with WhatsApp confirmation
Premium pastel boutique design with Playfair Display + Poppins typography
Fully responsive mobile-first layout with smooth hover animations
Product detail pages with quantity selector and WhatsApp order button
